policies.title: Colombian ordinary passports: Niger advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Colombia's current country-specific visitor table and Niger's Foreign Ministry both establish the ordinary visitor baseline as an advance consular Nigerien visa.
conditions: This covers short tourism or business travel on an ordinary Colombian passport only.
Colombia's current table says there is no conditional Colombian exemption and that neither eVisa nor visa on arrival is available for this route.

Niger's Foreign Ministry says visas are normally requested from its diplomatic or consular representation. Its exceptional border route requires Interior Minister authorisation and is not treated as the ordinary Colombian-passport baseline.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service and special-document treatment, carrier requirements and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Colombian ordinary passports: Syria advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Colombia's current visitor table and Syria's current civil-aviation entry publication establish an advance diplomatic-mission visa for an ordinary Colombian short visitor, not electronic issuance.
conditions: This applies to short tourism, business or family-visit travel using an ordinary Colombian passport.
The current Colombian table says an ordinary visa must be processed at a consulate; many visas are linked to a tour organised by an agency.
The organised-tour condition, security and operational requirements remain material. Work, residence, transit, special passports and final admission are outside scope.
